decision: Approve the intended BF-to-BG saved geometry/native-control transition for fixture promotion and subsequent complete frozen validation pipeline.
scope: Independent complete saved local/world BRep, properties/schema, hierarchy, expressions, controls, literal shaft geometry and dimensional checks; main and optional power context. This is not a final manufacturing/strength/flight qualification or a substitute for the full pipeline and preview.
source_binding_note: All gondola Python sources except config.py are bound. config.py is intentionally excluded to permit subsequent reviewed fixture repin; raw pre-promotion source fingerprint is preserved. Geometry changes after this review require re-review.

current_procurement_and_scope_metadata.ThreadStandard: Unthreaded purchased interface; no modeled thread.
current_procurement_and_scope_metadata.ShapeModelNotes: Nominal dimensional envelope only; material selection does not qualify strength, preload or retention. Helical threads and actual mass are unverified.
current_procurement_and_scope_metadata.PurchaseRequirements: SS304_CUT3_L34_FLAT5_A0: cut the selected nominal-diameter-3mm 304 stainless rod to 34 mm length. The cart contains 100/200 mm stock; this project key describes workshop preparation, not a supplier finished-shaft order. Cut square and deburr without a raised edge. Prepare one local flat, nominal depth 0.5 mm, length 5 mm, starting 0 mm from the reference end shown in CAD. A full-length flat is permitted on the input stub because it has no bearing journal. Keep every output-bearing journal round. Align the actual gear's radial set screw with the flat; tooth-to-screw clocking is not specified. Measure diameter, straightness and actual bearing/gear fit before cutting the full batch. Tolerance evidence is not a design blocker; the user accepts a replacement precision shaft if necessary. Use a precision nominal-3mm replacement rod if fit is inadequate; do not force an oversized or bent rod through bearings. Retention and torque transfer require physical trials.
current_procurement_and_scope_metadata.PurchaseEvidenceNotes: User selected nominal-3mm 304 rod options (100 mm and 200 mm) and authorized cutting/local-flat preparation. Seller diameter, roundness, straightness, material and length tolerances are unspecified. No h5 class, hard chrome, factory flat or guaranteed slip fit is claimed.

dimension_checks.scope: Neutral saved geometry only. Output gear face and nominal set-screw location are explicit reviewed literals. Actual screw point/protrusion/torque, unsupported shaft stiffness and retention remain unqualified. Full dynamic/contact/service checks are separate.

parametric_old_new_correlation.scope: Current unchanged frame/bridge/wire construction with only explicit BF/BG in-memory span/height inputs; both must match respective saved native geometry. This is a correlation check, not a new strength model. Sweep cylinders are independent literals. Central XY±25/27,Z0..13.4 witness mating plate/seat preservation.

preserved_functional_geometry: OEM horns, printed horn adapters, motor carriers, gears, input/idler shafts, bearings, rail, equipment carriers, electronic bodies and optics preserve local BRep. World changes are exactly expected raised input system and outward/raised pods. Output gear local Y compensation keeps gear axial planes fixed.
practical_limits: Driven shaft has a full 5 mm flat, with 4.5 mm axial overlap inside the gear hub; the 0.5 mm inward projection is deliberate. The nominal set-screw axis lies 2 mm from the nearer flat end.
The longer output overhang increases the unqualified stiffness/deflection and retention burden; numerical geometry does not establish adequate physical stiffness or screw torque.
Nominal M3 set-screw location is checked, but actual point, protrusion, clocking and tightening are not modeled or qualified.
Wire reservations remain planning geometry; full moving motor cable path, slack, tie fit and bend radius remain unqualified.
Mass deltas are density-based CAD estimates; unmeasured equipment/material properties are not converted to measured claims.
Final frozen native suite, complete ordered pipeline and visual preview remain root-owned completion gates.
